instruction: Candid photographic medium close-up with shallow depth of field in a ballet studio. In the blurred foreground, the red-haired girl in a pink leotard (R3) smiles with her arm raised. In the background, the light-brown-haired girl in a pink leotard (R1) stands with her arm raised. A female instructor in a black shirt stands between them, holding the hand of the light-brown-haired girl (R1). Bright, diffused indoor lighting fills the clean, minimalist space.
